title: The Governable Enterprise
subtitle: A Practical Guide to Evidence, Authority and AI Operations: Lessons from DeskOS
summary: A practitioner guide to designing AI operations that can explain their evidence, limit their authority, account for resources and recover from uncertainty, using DeskOS as a bounded case.

title: From Spreadsheet Interface to Governable Autonomy
subtitle: DeskOS as a Critical Design-Science Case of Evidence, Agency and Resource-Constrained AI Infrastructure
summary: A bounded implementation study that separates generated artifacts from verified intelligence and proposes an Evidence–Authority–Resource Contract with a prospective evaluation protocol. It reports no customer-outcome experiment.
